question: Which of the following was adopted by Lord Dalhousie to annex Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** The Doctrine of Lapse.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The Doctrine of lapse was a **pro-imperialist strategy** for expanding the British Kingdom's territory in India.
 
• **Lord Dalhousie **was the one who brought it up.
 
• The Doctrine equipped with an idea to **annex those states** which have** no heir,** get lapsed the right of ruling and it will not revert by adoption.
 
• The policy was not in favour of giving** titles and pensions** to monarchs' **adopted children.**
